title: Part (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a rectangular loop and a circular loop. For the rectangular loop, draw four lines: the first line from the start point at [0.0, 0.0] to the end point at [0.75, 0.0]; the second line from [0.75, 0.0] to [0.75, 0.093]; the third line from [0.75, 0.093] to [0.0, 0.093]; and the fourth line from [0.0, 0.093] back to [0.0, 0.0]. For the circular loop, draw a circle centered at [0.6458, 0.0465] with a radius of 0.0299. Apply a sketch scale of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by setting the Euler angles and translation vector to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0252 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. This will create a new solid body with dimensions: length 0.7500000303935622, width 0.09302325333539385, and height 0.025188474614034072.

Next, create another coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0252]. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a single rectangular loop. Draw four lines: the first line from the start point at [0.0, 0.0] to the end point at [0.0252, 0.0]; the second line from [0.0252, 0.0] to [0.0252, 0.093]; the third line from [0.0252, 0.093] to [0.0, 0.093]; and the fourth line from [0.0, 0.093] back to [0.0, 0.0]. Apply a sketch scale of 0.093 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by setting the Euler angles and translation vector to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.3778 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Join this part to the existing body. The resulting part has dimensions: length 0.02518847461403402, width 0.09302325333539385, and height 0.37782711921051104.

reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the first part (rectangular bar with a hole)
part_1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.093)
    .lineTo(0, 0.093)
    .close()
    .moveTo(0.6458, 0.0465)
    .circle(0.0299)
    .extrude(0.0252)
)

# Create the second part (rectangular extension)
part_2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(0.0252, 0)
    .lineTo(0.0252, 0.093)
    .lineTo(0, 0.093)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.3778)
    .translate((0, 0, 0.0252))
)

# Combine the two parts
r = part_1.union(part_2)

import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Rectangular Bar
part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.093).lineTo(0, 0.093).close().extrude(0.026)

# Part 2: Vertical Extension
part_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.026, 0).lineTo(0.026, 0.093).lineTo(0, 0.093).close().extrude(0.377)

# Translate part_2 to the correct position
part_2 = part_2.translate((0, 0, 0.026))

# Part 3: Circular Hole
part_3 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.026, 0.026).circle(0.026).extrude(-0.026)

# Translate part_3 to the correct position
part_3 = part_3.translate((0.621, 0.0205, 0.026))

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.union(part_2).cut(part_3)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Parameters
length = 0.75      # along X
width = 0.093      # along Y
thick = 0.03       # plate thickness
height = 0.403     # vertical leg height

# Horizontal leg (base plate) spanning full X
base = cq.Workplane("XY").box(length, width, thick, centered=False)

# Vertical leg at the left end (X = 0)
vert = cq.Workplane("XY").box(thick, width, height, centered=False)

# Combine legs
part = base.union(vert)

# Through hole in horizontal leg near the far end
hole_center_x = 0.65
hole_center_y = width / 2.0
hole_radius = 0.024

part = part.faces(">Z").workplane(origin=(0, 0, 0)) \
    .center(hole_center_x, hole_center_y) \
    .circle(hole_radius) \
    .cutThruAll()

r = part

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

L = 0.7500   # X
W = 0.0930   # Y
H = 0.4030   # Z
T = 0.0200   # plate thickness

# Horizontal leg
base = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L, W, T).translate((L / 2, W / 2, T / 2))

# Vertical leg at the left end
upright = cq.Workplane("XY").box(T, W, H).translate((T / 2, W / 2, H / 2))

# Through hole in the horizontal leg
hole = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.660, W / 2).circle(0.060 / 2).extrude(T + 0.002).translate((0, 0, -0.001))

r = base.union(upright).cut(hole)
